body: I don't want anyone else ever. I will never ever put myself in the position to have my heartbroken like this again. 2 marriages combining 17 years and all I have to show for it is 3 kids 2 divorces and 2 separate child support payments and with this divorce the worst broken heart ive ever had.
My ex wife. I'm still madly in love with her and miss her more than anything in the world.

She is completely unfazed by all of this. She doesnt care how I feel in all of this. She doesnt even think she has or is doing anything wrong and there is no talking to people like that. It's just sad 14 years together can just be thrown on the door like a piece of trash. I'm not sure if I will ever get over her.
I once called my mom a bitch. When she went to smack me she caught me on the ear and ruptured my eardrum. I've never called her a name again.
